en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two photographs. The upper image shows a large inn or guesthouse with multiple windows and a gabled roof, labeled as Nürnberger's inn 'zum Gerichts-Kretscham' in Siebeneichen, Kreis Löwenberg, with people standing and sitting in front of the building under trees. The lower image shows the railway station of Siebeneichen (Bahnhof Siebeneichen) with tracks in the foreground and a modest station building surrounded by trees.
